observations: Photo 0: Nikon D750 camera body with lens cap on, resting on a cardboard box labeled 'D750'. The brand 'Nikon' is visible on the top plate, and 'D750' is engraved on the front right side.
Photo 1: Top view of the camera showing the mode dial, hot shoe, and 'Nikon' branding. The 'D750' model name is visible on the front right side.
Photo 2: Rear view of the camera showing the LCD screen, which is dark and reflects the surroundings. The 'Nikon' logo is visible below the screen. The camera is still on the 'D750' box.
All photos show the camera body only; no lens, battery, charger, or other accessories are visible.
The camera appears to have some dust or smudges on the LCD screen and body, but no major physical damage is visible.

claims.claim: UK used Nikon D750 full-frame camera
claims.evidence: The model 'D750' is clearly visible on the camera body in photo 0 and photo 1. The 'Nikon' brand is visible on the top plate in photo 0 and photo 1. The 'full-frame' designation is standard for the D750 model and is not visually verifiable but is a known fact.
No accessories (lens, battery, charger, strap, etc.) are visible in any of the photos. The seller claims 'complete accessories' but provides no visual proof.

The camera body appears clean with no obvious dents or cracks, but the LCD screen has dust/smudges. The internal condition (shutter count, sensor cleanliness, functionality) is not visible. 'Excellent condition' is subjective and not proven by the photos.

risks.risk: Camera may not be functional (e.g., shutter failure, sensor damage, or dead battery)
risks.proof: A video clip showing the camera powering on, menu navigation, and taking a test photo with sound and image feedback.

risks.risk: Missing or non-functional accessories (e.g., no battery, no charger, or damaged lens)
risks.proof: Photos of all accessories laid out, including battery, charger, lens, strap, and any other claimed items, with close-ups of each.
risks.if_unproven: priced as accessories missing or non-functional

risks.risk: Camera may have high shutter count or sensor dust, reducing value
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the camera's shutter count via menu, and a test shot taken in a dark room to check for sensor dust.
risks.if_unproven: priced as high shutter count or dusty sensor

risks.risk: Camera may be stolen or imported illegally (UK origin claim may be unverified)
risks.proof: A photo of the camera's serial number and a copy of the original purchase receipt or warranty card from a UK retailer.
risks.if_unproven: priced as origin unverified, with potential import risk

proof_requests: Video showing the camera powering on, menu navigation, and taking a test photo.
Photos of all accessories (battery, charger, lens, strap, etc.) laid out clearly.
Photo of the camera's serial number and any original documentation.
Test shot taken in a dark room to check for sensor dust.
response.reason: The camera model is clearly identified as a Nikon D750, but the seller's claims about 'complete accessories' and 'excellent condition' are not visually supported. Critical hidden risks include functionality, accessory completeness, shutter count, and sensor condition. Without proof of these, the item cannot be priced accurately and must be asked for further evidence.
